name: Kamikawa (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kamikawa town emblem in green and blue: a green ring with a blue stylised leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Kamikawa, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 7 November 2005.

features.role: Kamikawa town emblem — a green ring with a blue stylised leaf
